data.body_html:
Looking for a Cabopino boat rental that departs directly from Cabopino Marina? While our standard fleet operates from Puerto Banús, we can arrange pickups from Cabopino for groups of 10 or more on select yachts. This guide covers everything you need to know about chartering a boat from Cabopino, including pricing, destinations, and how to book.

Why Choose Cabopino Marina for Your Boat Rental?

Cabopino Marina is a quieter alternative to Puerto Banús, with free parking, sandy beaches, and a relaxed atmosphere. It offers direct access to the Costa del Sol's best coves, including Cala del Faro and Cala Cortés. The marina has several beachfront restaurants and bars, making it ideal for a pre- or post-charter meal. If you're staying in the eastern part of Marbella or near the Golden Mile, Cabopino is just a 15-minute drive away.

Our Fleet for Cabopino Departures

For Cabopino pickups, we recommend our larger yachts that can accommodate 10–12 guests. These include:

  • Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax) – luxury flybridge with spacious sundeck
  • Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) – high-performance open yacht with jet ski included
  • Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax) – classic motor yacht with elegant interior

Smaller boats like the Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 depart from Puerto Banús, which is a short taxi ride from Cabopino. Browse all available boats for your trip.

Cabopino Boat Rental Prices

Our pricing is straightforward and includes everything you need:

Boat TierDurationPrice (incl. VAT)
Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39)2 hours€749
Tier A (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39)8 hours€2,299
Tier B (Mangusta 80)4 hours (min.)€4,719
Other yachts (Ferretti 94, Canados 86)On requestContact via WhatsApp

All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT. Tier B also includes a free jet ski.

Best Destinations from Cabopino

From Cabopino Marina, you can reach several beautiful spots within 30 minutes:

  • Cala del Faro – 15 minutes west, a secluded cove with crystal-clear water
  • Cala Cortés – 20 minutes east, popular for snorkelling and cliff jumping
  • Estepona Coast – 30 minutes west, with views of La Concha mountain
  • Sotogrande – 40 minutes east, a luxury marina worth visiting

Your skipper will tailor the route based on weather and your preferences. Learn more about Cabopino boat rental options.

How to Book a Cabopino Boat Rental

Booking is simple: contact us via WhatsApp with your preferred date, group size, and desired boat. We'll confirm availability and send a payment link for the 50% deposit. The remaining balance is due 7 days before departure. For groups of 10 or more, we can arrange pickup from Cabopino Marina directly.

What to Expect on Your Charter

Your charter includes a licensed skipper who knows the local waters. You'll be provided with water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. Feel free to bring your own food and drinks – there's no corkage fee. The boat is equipped with safety gear, insurance, and a sound system. Just bring sunscreen, swimwear, and a towel.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I rent a boat directly from Cabopino Marina?

Yes, we can arrange pickups from Cabopino Marina for groups of 10 or more on our larger yachts like the Ferretti 94 or Mangusta 80. Smaller boats depart from Puerto Banús, which is a 15-minute taxi ride from Cabopino. Contact us via WhatsApp for pricing and availability.

What is the cost of a Cabopino boat rental?

Our Tier A boats (Astondoa 40, Azimut 39) start at €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours. Tier B boats (Mangusta 80) are €4,719 for a minimum of 4 hours and include a free jet ski. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and 21% VAT.

What is included in the charter price?

Every charter includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish IVA (21%). There are no hidden fees.

Which coves can I visit from Cabopino?

Popular destinations include Cala del Faro, Cala Cortés, and the coast towards Estepona. These coves offer crystal-clear water for swimming and snorkelling. Your skipper will recommend the best spots based on weather conditions.

How do I get to Cabopino Marina from Marbella?

Cabopino Marina is located 10 km east of Marbella town centre. You can drive there in 15 minutes via the A-7 highway. Free parking is available at the marina. Taxis from Marbella cost around €20-25.

Can I bring my own food and drinks?

Yes, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks. Our standard package already includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks. There is no corkage fee.

What is the maximum number of passengers?

Our boats accommodate between 5 and 12 passengers. The Astondoa 40 and Azimut 39 take 9-11 guests, while the Mangusta 80 and Ferretti 94 take up to 12. For larger groups, please contact us for custom solutions.

Is a deposit required to book?

Yes, a 50% deposit is required to secure your booking. The remaining balance is due 7 days before departure. We accept bank transfers and credit cards. Cancellations made more than 14 days in advance receive a full refund.
